register.p: Then register it in ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json. Merge this into the file, keeping every server already there. Create the file if it doesn't exist. If a {{SERVER}} entry already exists, ask the user before replacing it.
{{ABS_NOTE}} {{WIN_ABS_NOTE}} OpenCode's key is mcp, the type is local, and command is one array holding both paths. timeout is in milliseconds.

confirm.p: It should list {{SERVER}} as connected. Restart OpenCode to load it.
